taurajo_guard: Camp Taurajo. North gate - the Crossroads road. The south gate opens on the Southern Barrens. Orgrimmar posts a few of us here to stand with the tauren, and since the bluffs fell there are a great many more tauren to stand with.
taurajo_elder: Longtread. I am eldest here, and since Thunder Bluff fell and Cairne was lost to us, the tribes look to this camp and so to me. I did not ask for it. Sit, if you have a moment - there is more to carry than I have shoulders for.
taurajo_hunter_1: Kala. I hunt for the camp. The kodo herds moved south early this year, down toward the Field of Giants, and herds don't move early without a reason behind them.
taurajo_totem_carver: Ahonen, carver. Every totem in this camp came off my bench. Each one holds a spirit's promise - carve it wrong and the promise breaks. Mind the shavings, they're sorted.
taurajo_hide_tanner: Mosswalker. I tan for the camp - a kodo gives its hide once it's done giving everything else, and we waste nothing. The quilboar in the south waste everything, and they're coming this way.
taurajo_drum_keeper: Rohan. I keep the war drums. They haven't sounded in a generation - not even when Thunder Bluff fell, because there was no one left up there to answer. I keep them ready all the same.
taurajo_kodo_wrangler: Tull. I wrangle the camp's kodo and I know the roads south better than anyone here - the Rift, the dwarves' dig at Bael Modan, the pass down to the aspen country. Kodo don't spook easy. When they do, get out of the way. All of it.
taurajo_young_calf: Grandmother says I'll be tall as the totem pole someday. I was born in Thunder Bluff. I don't remember it, but she says it was taller than anything.
taurajo_warband_scout: Ashhoof. I scout for the camp's warband. The Kolkar have been raiding the roads all season, and a scout who waits for the report to come to him is a scout with nothing to report. Walk with me.
taurajo_orc_liaison: Grukdar, liaison from Orgrimmar. The Warchief sends grain; the tauren send warriors. A fair trade, and since Mulgore was lost it's the trade keeping this camp fed.
taurajo_healer: Mara. I tend the camp's wounded and I listen to the earth, and lately the second is harder than the first. Something in the south has it flinching.
taurajo_innkeeper: Mahkra. This is Taurajo's inn - rest easy, traveller. The Earth Mother watches this hearth, and you may make it yours.
taurajo_flight_master: Kaya, windrider master. The winds carry word and wings alike. I fly to anywhere you have already walked.
taurajo_riding_trainer: Tull Greyhoof. I teach riding. A kodo carries you if you carry yourself right - that takes a certain level of experience, and a certain amount of coin.
ct_taurajo: Greyhoof. I train every discipline for the camp - brave, shaman, druid, or whatever the newcomers turn out to be. Show me what you know.
pt_taurajo_forge: Baine - no, not that one. I teach mining and smithing. The camp has no forge of its own; the nearest is at the Crossroads, up the north road.
pt_taurajo_herbs: Runetotem, of the old line. Herbalism and alchemy. The plains give medicine freely if you ask in the right season. I'll teach you the asking.
pt_taurajo_wood: Sunwalker. Woodcutting and woodworking. There's little enough timber on the plains, so we waste none - and for a sawmill you'll want the Crossroads.
pt_taurajo_hide: Ahnu. Skinning, leatherworking, tailoring and cooking. The plains are hide and meat from horizon to horizon, and I'll teach you to honour both.
pt_taurajo_essence: Hamuul - my mother admired the Archdruid. I teach engineering, which he would not have. Metal, a crystal from an ore vein, and patience.
